## Summary

- What changed?
- Why is this the right layer for the change?

## Evidence

- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] No model weights or run artifacts are included
- [ ] New trace data is labeled by source (output, scratchpad, activation, attention, or J-space)
- [ ] UI changes include an unavailable/empty state

## Branch target

- Feature and fix branches target `dev`.
- Only release promotions target `main`.
